name: Natsushima Misaki
source: The protagonist's cold and serious younger sister. She has loved her onii-chan for a very long time, but in order to suppress these feelings, she is very strict to him. The two of them lives alone together and the housework is entirely handled by Misaki. She has admired Nagisa ever since she was saved by her when she was in some trouble.
